messages:
Maya R.: quick thought: our current left nav mixes objects and workflows. i'm proposing a small experiment: group by user intent (Build, Run, Monitor, Admin) and surface a tiny horizontal "Shortcuts" pill bar above the content area for deep links. keeps nav semantic and reduces cognitive load.
Leo T.: nice. do you have a sketch? curious how crumbs will reflect this grouping — should breadcrumb read the intent or the product area?
Maya R.: sketch attached in figma but tl;dr: breadcrumb mirrors the path segments so it will read intent > resource > item. example: Build / Models / model-foo. keeps back-button behavior intuitive.
Sofia P.: accessibility reminders: ensure the Shortcuts pillbar is reachable via skip links and that items have visible focus rings. Also announce expanded/collapsed groups to screen readers.
Omar K.: router implications: prefer pathname-based routes like `/org/:orgId/intent/:intent/:resource/:id`. For older bookmarked links we'll translate old paths to new ones server-side and support `#` hash fallbacks on client. We should document the redirect map.
Maya R.: copy question: "Monitor" vs "Metrics & Traces" — which is clearer? i worry Monitor is vague.
Leo T.: Metrics & Traces is explicit but long. Maybe show long form in tooltip and short label in nav.
Sofia P.: agreed. tooltip approach helps, but tooltips must be keyboard accessible.
Omar K.: on implementation: i can add route aliases and a small migration layer in the router. sample: `routeAliasMap['/observability/*'] = '/intent/monitor/$1'`. will handle both server redirects and client rewrite.
Maya R.: decision checklist: 1) adopt intent-based groups, 2) add Shortcuts pillbar with skip-link, 3) breadcrumb from path segments, 4) pathname-first router with hash fallback and alias map, 5) nav labels short with tooltip for long form. thumbs?
Leo T.: +1. will prototype the collapsed state and animation.
Sofia P.: +1 from a11y side. i'll write the acceptance criteria for keyboard and SR testing.
Omar K.: +1. i'll open a spike PR for alias map and hash fallback.
ui-bot: Created task RED-INF-4377: "Nav IA: intent groups + shortcuts + router aliasing" assigned to @Omar K., @Sofia P., @Leo T. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-INF-4377
Maya R.: thanks team. i'll add the figma link and schedule a 20m sync if anyone wants to review the prototype. :spiral_calendar:
_meta: Slack thread about console navigation IA changes: intent-based left nav grouping, shortcuts pillbar, breadcrumbs reflecting path segments, pathname-first routing with hash fallback and alias mapping. Compact, realistic Slack-style messages.
